name: policy-doc-sync
description: Warn when PRD.md and ARCHITECTURE.md are modified without corresponding counterpart updates.

hooks.command: sh -lc 'changed=$(git diff --name-only -- PRD.md ARCHITECTURE.md); has_prd=$(printf "%s" "$changed" | grep -c "^PRD.md$"); has_arch=$(printf "%s" "$changed" | grep -c "^ARCHITECTURE.md$"); if [ "$has_prd" -gt 0 ] && [ "$has_arch" -eq 0 ]; then echo "POLICY-DOC-SYNC: PRD.md changed without ARCHITECTURE.md update. Review architecture alignment."; exit 2; fi; if [ "$has_arch" -gt 0 ] && [ "$has_prd" -eq 0 ]; then echo "POLICY-DOC-SYNC: ARCHITECTURE.md changed without PRD.md update. Review requirements alignment."; exit 2; fi; exit 0'
